privacy.description: How we collect, use, share and protect your data.
privacy.meta: Privacy Policy for the Fast Scheduler Telegram bot: scheduling, recurring posts, sender bots, channels, statistics and payments.

changelog.summary: This edition adds the website’s analytics disclosure: Google Analytics 4, delivered through Google Tag Manager and loaded only after you press Accept.
bullets: A named analytics section: Google Tag Manager / GA4, what is measured, and the two cookies it sets.
Consent is stated as the gate: before a choice, nothing is inserted into the page at all.
Declining is described as leaving every page, feature and download fully available.

refundpolicy.description: How Premium refunds, renewals and chargebacks work.
refundpolicy.meta: Fast Scheduler refund policy: how Telegram Stars refunds work for @FastSchedulerBot Premium, the 7-day per-payment window, cancellations and how to request a refund.

changelog.summary: Premium is now non-refundable once it has been delivered. The only refund case is non-delivery — paid but never activated, or the same period charged twice — and the request must reach us within 7 days of that payment.
bullets: The discretionary-refund list is gone: delivery and use make the purchase final.
The 7-day window now applies to non-delivery requests only, still counted per payment.
